questions.q: How is a startup defined in the video?
o: A company that sells only online
A team that creates an innovative product as a solution to a validated problem with potential for rapid growth
questions.e: In the video: "Startap predstavlja tim koji razvija inovativan proizvod ili uslugu kao rešenje za potvrđen problem sa potencijalom za brz rast".

questions.q: How many people are usually on a startup team?
questions.e: In the video: "u startapu najčešće dvoje do petoro ljudi" — most often two to five people.

questions.q: What do investors look at first in a pitch?
questions.e: In the video: "jedna od glavnih stvari koju će gledati jeste koliko im se sviđa tim".

questions.q: What is B2C?
questions.e: In the video: "krajnjim korisnicima, odnosno kastomerima, i tada se to naziva B2C, odnosno business to consumer.".

questions.q: What should come first — the problem or the solution?
questions.e: In the video: "prvo morate da imate potvrđen problem za koji kreirate vaše rešenje".

questions.q: How can you check that people really have a problem?
o: Look it up on the internet
Talk to users: interviews, a survey
questions.e: In the video: "Da li ste pričali sa vašim korisnicima, da li ste odradili intervjue, da li ste odradili neku anketu".

questions.q: What example of a problem is given in the video?
o: City dwellers are busy and have no time to cook, but want quality food at home
There are few parks in cities
There is no internet in villages
questions.e: In the video: "ljudi u urbanim sredinama veoma zauzeti, da nemaju vremena sami da kuvaju svoju hranu".

questions.q: What time frame should you think about for entering the global market?
questions.e: In the video: "u nekih narednih 5 do 7 godina razmišljate o izlasku na nova tržišta, na globalno tržište".

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Tim treba da bude *raznolik*.
questions.e: Raznolik — diverse, varied.

questions.q: Prvo morate da imate *potvrđen* problem.
questions.e: Potvrditi — to confirm; potvrđen — confirmed.

questions.q: Pičovali ste ideju pred *investitorima*.
questions.e: Investitor — investor; pred investitorima — in front of investors.

questions.q: Da li ste istražili *tržište*?
questions.e: Tržište — market; istražiti — to research.

questions.q: Ljudi u urbanim sredinama su veoma *zauzeti*.
questions.e: Zauzet — busy.

questions.q: Da li ste odradili neku *anketu*?
questions.e: Anketa — a survey, questionnaire.

questions.q: Ne možete prvo da smislite *rešenje*.
questions.e: Rešenje — solution; rešiti — to solve.

questions.q: Da li možete da je *proširite* i ponudite velikom broju korisnika?
questions.e: Proširiti — to expand; širok — wide.

questions.q: U ovom ___ pričamo o tome šta je startap.
questions.e: U in answer to "where?" requires the locative case: u ovom videu.

questions.q: Pičovali ste ideju pred ___.
questions.e: Pred ("in front of") in answer to "where?" requires the instrumental case: pred investitorima.

questions.q: Najčešće dvoje do petoro ___.
questions.e: After dvoje/petoro the genitive plural is used: ljudi.

questions.q: Da li ste pričali sa vašim ___?
questions.e: Sa ("with") requires the instrumental case: sa korisnicima.

questions.q: Da li ste istražili ___?
questions.e: Istražiti + object — accusative case; for neuter nouns it coincides with the nominative: tržište.

questions.q: U narednih 5 do 7 ___.
questions.e: After numbers from 5 the genitive plural is used: godina.

questions.q: Razmišljate o izlasku na nova ___.
questions.e: Na in answer to "where to?" requires the accusative plural: nova tržišta.

questions.q: Voleli bi u svom ___ da jedu kvalitetnu hranu.
questions.e: U in answer to "where?" — locative case: u svom domu.
